sources.title: RSNA launches 2026 Knee Abnormality Detection AI Challenge
sources.snippet: The RSNA has launched its 2026 Knee Abnormality Detection AI Challenge, inviting researchers to develop machine-learning models to detect and classify knee abnormalities on MRI using both images and radiology report text.
